contributions.detail: This report's Form A is a TYPED FILER ATTACHMENT (page 9, 'CONTRIBUTION REPORT'), not the printed Form A sheet. Its 8 rows sum to 7,100.00, equal to the attachment's own TOTAL -- where a typed '$6,100' is STRUCK OUT and '7,100' hand-written and circled in blue beside it -- and equal to the cover's line-1 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT. It is NOT the cumulative 7,730.00 (= 630.00 carried from report 1 + 7,100.00), so THE SCOPE IS PERIOD, a different scope from the cumulative figure this module publishes; the addendum says reconciles_* is expected to stay blank for that and it is not a failure. Line 2 (sub-$50 aggregate) is blank in all three columns, so no small-donor aggregate competes.

expenditures.detail: This report's Form B is a TYPED FILER ATTACHMENT (page 8, 'EXPENDITURE REPORT'). Its 27 rows sum to 6,196.06 EXACTLY -- equal to the hand-written total the filer wrote below his own struck-out typed TOTAL of '$6,095.09' (which is wrong by 100.97 and is reported here only as the struck figure), and equal to the cover's line-3 THIS REPORT cell. Not the cumulative 8,228.89, so scope is PERIOD. The cover's own cents group on line-3 CUMULATIVE is overwritten (a corrected superscript with a caret); 8,228.89 is settled by two independent chains: 2,032.83 + 6,196.06 = 8,228.89 and 7,730.00 - 8,228.89 = -498.89, the printed line-4 cumulative.

gates.page_subtotal: Generation-1 sheets (pages 2,3,5,6) print NO schedule total -- the cover lines are the only anchors there, and schedule_total is null for reports 1 and 2. Report 3's schedules are typed filer attachments that DO print their own totals, and both are struck-and-corrected: p9 contributions rows 7,100.00 = the circled hand-written 7,100 replacing a struck typed '$6,100' = cover line1-THIS; p8 expenditures rows 6,196.06 = the hand-written 6,196.06 replacing a struck typed '$6,095.09' = cover line3-THIS. Report 1: p2 rows 630.00 (excluding the candidate's own loan line) = cover line1-CUM; p3 rows 2,032.83 = cover line3. Report 2: both sheets blank, cover zeros. EVERY gate fires exactly; none failed to gate.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 reports geometry_status 'ok', 37 h-rules / 36 bands over the ~36-writing-line gen-1 sheet, pitch 2.28% of page height, header rule at 9.02% -- 11 inked lines, 11 rows emitted, band 12 renders empty. p2 same grid, 3 inked lines, 3 rows emitted, band 4 renders empty. Pages 5 and 6 were read in full at 200 dpi: every writing line is empty (only faint show-through from the reverse of the photocopied sheet), 0 rows. Pages 8 and 9 are unruled typed lists, so rowbands does not apply -- rows were counted by eye against the printed line spacing and confirmed by the control crops (28th / 9th line render empty) and by the sums closing exactly.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: 600-dpi crops of row 1 and row 3 amount boxes render '130.00' and '1402.83'; the control one pitch below row 3 renders EMPTY. p3: row 1 renders '25.36', row 11 renders '110.00', control row 12 renders EMPTY. p8: row 1 renders '$103.35', row 27 renders '$361.71', control row 28 renders EMPTY. p9 (page stored rotated): geometry is emitted in the UN-ROTATED portrait frame, where the amount cells form a VERTICAL strip at y 82.73%-89.55% and successive rows advance in the -x direction with a 2.45%-of-width pitch; the 600-dpi crop of row 1's box renders '$1,000' (after a 90-degree view rotation), row 8's renders '$500', and the control one pitch further renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: RUN ACROSS ALL THREE COVERS IN THE BUNDLE -- this is the check a single page cannot see, and it found a real defect. Report 1: 630.00 + 0 - 2,032.83 = -1,402.83 = printed line-4 CUM, closes exactly (and proves the 1,402.83 candidate loan on Form A is not counted as a contribution). Report 3 closes twice over: 630.00 + 7,100.00 = 7,730.00 (line 1); 2,032.83 + 6,196.06 = 8,228.89 (line 3); 7,730.00 - 8,228.89 = -498.89 = printed line-4 CUM; and 7,100.00 - 6,196.06 = 903.94 = printed line-4 THIS. Report 3's carry-forward cells chain correctly to REPORT 1 (line1-LAST 630 = report 1's line1-CUM; line3-LAST 2,032.83 = report 1's line3-CUM; line4-LAST -1,402.83 = report 1's balance). REPORT 2'S COVER IS MIS-KEYED and does NOT chain: its line-1 TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT is a slashed zero where report 1's cumulative was 630.00, and its line-3 LAST and CUMULATIVE cells read -1,402.83 -- report 1's BALANCE written into the EXPENSE slot instead of 2,032.83. Reported as printed; nothing recomputed. Only report 2's line-4 balance (-1,402.83) carries forward correctly, and report 3 ignores report 2's line 1 and line 3 entirely.

notes: BUNDLE OF THREE REPORTS in one PDF (n_reports_in_pdf = 3, AGREEING with the chunk file's n_reports = 3): pages 1-3 = the 4/4/2014 report, pages 4-6 = the 6/17/2014 report (both schedules blank), pages 7-9 = the October 2014 report, whose schedules are TYPED FILER ATTACHMENTS rather than the printed Form A/B sheets. The reports are in chronological order. THE SCHEDULES ARE NOT PHOTOCOPIED ACROSS REPORTS -- each report carries its own distinct ledger, which together with the scope test is why reports 1 and 3 land on different scopes (report 1 is the first of the cycle so its scopes coincide; report 3's schedules are strictly per-period). All three covers are Generation-1 Carr Printing 5-5-PG forms citing Utah Code 17-16-6.5, and none has an in-kind column, so in_kind is false everywhere by form design and was never inferred. CHUNK FILE AGREES WITH THE DOCUMENT: 'Victor Moses Iverson' matches all three covers' Full Name of Candidate; office 'Commission Seat B' matches 'Washington County Commissioner, Seat B' (report 1), 'County Commission Seat B' + Office District 'Seat B' (report 2), and 'Washington County Commission' + Office District 'Seat B' (report 3). County office, in scope. Report 3's cover Date line reads 9/27/2014 while the clerk's RECEIVED stamp reads OCT 28 2014 -- kept verbatim, not corrected. Two of the three cover totals carry filer corrections that are reported as printed and never recomputed: report 2's line-3 balance-in-expense-slot mis-key (see balance_chain) and report 3's overwritten line-3 cumulative cents. Both typed attachments carry a WRONG printed TOTAL struck out by hand with the right figure written beside it ($6,100 -> 7,100 and $6,095.09 -> 6,196.06); in both cases my rows sum to the CORRECTED figure exactly. Every amount in the document is legible; no row is blank for illegibility and no side is a floor. Three expenditure dates are unusable as written (two ranges and one year-less '24-Jul') and are BLANK with needs_review=1, verbatim kept in the note. Candidate home street address, home and business phones and ZIP printed in the clear on all three covers were discarded at read time, as were every donor street address, PO box and ZIP.
